Vegetarian Restaurant in Saigon
Jun 2018 • Solo
I am not a fan of vegetarian food, my wife can attest to this but after my first time dining here, makes me want to recommend all my friends to give this place a try.

These were the food I tried with the captain's recommendation :-

i) Banana Blossom Salad - this is the one I like most. Though this is rated spicy on the menu, it's not spicy at all and it is super fresh and delicious. Portion is big enough for 2. Must try!
ii) Pumpkin-Carrot Soup with Ginger and Coconut Chips
iii) Fried Triangle Spring Roll with Lemon leaf dipping Sauce
iv) Crispy Oyster Mushroom Tempura served with beetroot fried rice - the portion is good for 1.
v) Mango smoothie - very good. Must try!

The restaurant has a nice setup and is very cosy and my food was served very fast.

Not acceptable if you are in business
Apr 2018 • Couples
Oh dear.

I travelled 45 minutes to get to biogarten and arrived at 2113 on a Thursday evening with just two customers in the restaurant finishing their meal. 

‘We are closed! we are told. 

Come on guys, I’m a regular here! 

Even if I’m not don’t turn away business!! Prospective customers! This is a great restaurant with amazing food but with zero marketing ability or customer service nous. Surely you can stay open to take one order? 

If biogarten respond to this bad review I may eat there again but guys you have a great product here but NO idea at all how to promote it effectively- take a look at all the empty tables and wonder how much money you are losing on a daily basis...

I await your response. I’m peeved.

If you read my other reviews you know I’m very fussy about restaurants but!
Jan 2018 • Couples
This is excellent. If you are in need of some genuinely healthy and well presented food at good prices, come here.
The staff are friendly and attentive and the atmosphere is subdued and peaceful. For veggies and vegans it’s perfect but there’s a dish here to please everyone.
One of the two head chefs Roshan even came over to introduce himself, much appreciated.
It’s Vietnam’s answer to Thailand’s excellent veggie restaurant in Pattaya, 5 star D. 

Go! Go! Go!
